resources.string: Bookmarks stay on this phone, up to 200 per account. Download files separately. Forum bookmarks are not synced.
Source unavailable in saved data. Load the course or refresh its source, or remove this bookmark.
Opens the university website; browser sign-in or a network connection may be required.
Bookmark items from workspace search or course discussions. Add an official UIT link here.
Connect an account from your profile settings to keep its bookmarks separate.
Choose the account that owns this local bookmark. Only public HTTPS links on UIT domains are accepted; do not paste sign-in or session links.
Some saved bookmarks could not be read. Existing data is retained; try Reload saved list.
The bookmark could not be saved or removed. Check the connected account and the 200-item limit, then retry.
Enter a title and a public UIT HTTPS link without passwords, tokens or sign-in parameters.
That source is no longer in the connected saved workspace. Refresh its course or remove the bookmark.
No browser could open this link. Install or enable a browser and try again.
